summary: The cisco.dnac collection is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 14 unless it regains a maintainer.
questions: Is cisco.dnac being removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: cisco.dnac is deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: As of Ansible 13.6.0, `cisco.dnac` is deprecated and will be **removed from Ansible 14** unless someone starts maintaining it again before then.
